items.title: Drop spare keys at the front office
items.quote: please drop your spare keys at the front office Saturday at 6pm at the latest
items.note: Before the change: 6 PM EDT = 22:00 UTC.

items.title: Call Theo about the inspection
items.quote: Can you call me Monday at 9am about the inspection?
items.note: After the change: 9 AM EST = 14:00 UTC (13:00 would mean the old offset was used).

items.title: Inspection report from the inspector
items.quote: The inspector will send her report by Nov 6.
items.note: No name for the inspector in the source: counterparty must stay null (rule 3, never fill a name).
